title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach Angriff und Schussabgaben auf 31-Jährigen

extraction.summaryEn: Following up on a December 2025 shooting in Haselhorst, police and prosecutors searched 14 properties citywide and arrested suspects. Seven men aged 21 to 28 are suspected of attempted manslaughter over shots fired at a 31-year-old.
